invariants.rationale: Method always returns a HoodieMergeHandle, constructed via a static factory method.
instantTime is propagation of input param and typically must not be null or empty for update/merge actions in Hudi.
partitionPath is used downstream and should not be null for correct handle creation.
A file identifier for merging must be defined and non-empty for valid update handle creation.
Map of records to update is passed to the merge handle factory, so must be non-null at this return point.
